newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen continuing slight downtrend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen continuing slight downtrend.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall for the fourth session runnning on Tuesday as buyers show caution in the run-up to September's parliamentary vote.

Analysts said macroeconomic concerns such as higher money supply auguring higher market rates would also dampen buying but that the roughly mixed buying and selling after price fixing in recent sessions signalled no major sell-off.
Budimex was expected to extend its recent tumble sparked by Thursday's news it had revised down its 1997 pre-tax profit forecasts.
